name: Ancient Civilizations
description: Peru was home to various ancient civilizations such as the Norte Chico civilization and the Moche civilization.

name: Inca Empire
description: The Inca Empire, known as Tawantinsuyu, was established and became the largest empire in pre-Columbian America.

name: Spanish Conquest
description: Spanish conquistadors, led by Francisco Pizarro, conquered the Inca Empire, marking the beginning of Spanish colonial rule.

name: Viceroyalty of Peru
description: Peru became part of the Viceroyalty of Peru, a colonial administrative district of the Spanish Empire.

name: Peruvian Independence
description: Peru gained independence from Spain and became a republic under the leadership of Jose de la Riva-Agüero.

name: Peruvian-Bolivian Confederation
description: Peru and Bolivia formed a confederation under the leadership of Andrés de Santa Cruz.

name: Guano Era
description: Peru experienced an economic boom due to the export of guano, a valuable source of fertilizer.

name: War of the Pacific
description: Peru fought against Chile and lost significant territory, including the provinces of Tarapacá and Arica.

name: Rubber Boom
description: The extraction of rubber in the Amazon region brought wealth and exploitation to Peru.

name: Peruvian Agrarian Reform
description: President Juan Velasco Alvarado implemented a series of agrarian reforms aimed at redistributing land to peasants.

name: Shining Path Insurgency
description: The Maoist insurgency, led by the Shining Path, caused political and social turmoil in Peru.

name: Peruvian Economic Boom
description: Peru experienced a period of economic growth due to increased mining and foreign investment.

name: Presidential Crisis
description: Peru faced a political crisis with multiple presidents being impeached or resigning.

name: COVID-19 Pandemic
description: Peru, like many countries, faced the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Recent Elections
description: Peru held presidential elections marking a changing political landscape in the country.
